question: According to Global Multidimensional poverty index (2022), which of the following groups of states is included in top 10 poorest states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya and Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meghalaya and Madhya Pradesh** are included in the **top 10 poorest states of India** according to the **Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (2022)**.
 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) assesses poverty at the individual level by considering various deprivations people face in their daily lives, such as **health, education, and living standards**.
 
• States like Meghalaya and Madhya Pradesh have shown significant levels of poverty in multiple dimensions, contributing to their ranking in the top 10 poorest states of India.
 
• The MPI is a valuable tool for understanding the complexity of poverty and for shaping policies aimed at poverty alleviation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)** is developed by the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)** and the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**.
 
• The MPI complements traditional income-based measures of poverty by considering overlapping deprivations in health, education, and living standards.
 
• India has made significant progress in reducing poverty, but regional disparities remain, with some states still facing high levels of multidimensional poverty.
 
• Addressing multidimensional poverty requires targeted interventions in areas such as healthcare, education, sanitation, and housing.
 
• The MPI can help policymakers identify priority areas for investment and track the effectiveness of poverty reduction strategies over time.
